label: Released
definition: Date the weights (or, if earlier, the technical report) were first made public, YYYY-MM-DD, as dated by the publisher. A Hugging Face repository creation date is used only when no dated publisher page exists, with a note.

label: License
definition: License of the released weights as declared by the publisher (model card metadata or license file), e.g. apache-2.0, mit, or the name of a custom license.

label: Input modalities
definition: Input modalities of the released checkpoint as the publisher states them, from: text, image, video, audio, joined with ' + ' in that order ("text", "text + image + video").

label: Total params
definition: Total parameter count as reported by the publisher. See params.note for whether embeddings, MTP heads or vision towers are included.

label: Active params
definition: Parameters used per token in the forward pass, as reported by the publisher.

label: Active params (prefill)
definition: Parameters used per prompt token during prefill when the publisher states it differs from decode (e.g. YOCO-style designs that skip the upper half of the stack).

label: Active non-embedding (stated)
definition: Active parameters excluding the input embedding and the output head (unembedding). Stated by the publisher, or computed from params.active by subtracting vocab × d_model for each of the embedding and output head that params.active is stated to include (basis inferred, note with the arithmetic). Not disclosed when the scope of params.active is not stated.

label: Counted total params
definition: Parameters of the text backbone counted from the released checkpoint's safetensors headers (embedding, output head, all experts and other weights; excluding MTP modules, vision/audio towers and n-gram lookup tables). Shown only when the counts reproduce the publisher's stated total and active parameters within 5% under some scope.

label: Counted embedding + head
definition: Input embedding plus output head (once if tied), counted from the checkpoint.

label: Counted lookup tables
definition: Parameters in n-gram / Engram / per-layer embedding tables counted from the checkpoint. Like the token embedding, they are lookups and are excluded from params.counted_total and params.counted_active_non_embedding.

label: Non-emb. params (counted)
definition: Language backbone weights excluding input embeddings, output head, lookup/Engram tables, MTP modules and vision/audio towers. Equals params.counted_total minus params.counted_embedding. Same validation as params.counted_total.

label: Largest layer (counted)
definition: Largest group of language-backbone weights sharing a full layers.<index> tensor path, including every routed expert. Excludes lookup/Engram tables, embeddings, output head, MTP and other modalities. Hybrid checkpoints may store mixers and FFNs as separate layers. All-gather volume also depends on wrapping, sharding and dtype.

label: Active non-emb. (counted)
definition: Active parameters per token excluding the input embedding and output head, counted from the checkpoint as all non-expert weights plus routed-expert weights × top_k / experts. Same validation as params.counted_total.

label: Counting scope
definition: What the publisher's counts include or exclude (MTP modules, embeddings, vision encoder, n-gram tables).

label: Embedding params
definition: Parameters in input embedding and output head, as reported.

label: Non-embedding params
definition: Parameters excluding embedding and output head, as reported.

label: Layers
definition: Number of transformer blocks in the main backbone (attention or token mixer plus FFN), excluding MTP modules.

label: d_model
definition: Residual stream width.

label: Vocab
definition: Embedding table rows (vocab_size in config, may include padding).

label: Tied embeddings
definition: Input embedding and output head share weights.

label: Lookup memory
definition: Hashed n-gram or conditional-memory tables outside the dense backbone (Engram, n-gram embeddings), with size and placement.

label: Tokenizer
definition: Tokenizer type and lineage as described by the publisher (e.g. byte-level BPE shared with an earlier model).

label: d_model / layers
definition: Width-to-depth ratio, d_model divided by the number of blocks.

label: Token mixers
definition: Token-mixing layer types in the backbone, e.g. GQA, MLA, SWA, Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, DSA (DeepSeek sparse attention).

label: Layer layout
definition: Token-mixer order, summarized as a pattern or layer positions. The fact's optional sequence lists each mixer in order; a ratio alone does not establish the order. Auxiliary prediction modules and standalone FFNs are excluded.

label: Global-attention layers
definition: Layers whose KV cache grows with full context (dense or sparse global attention, MLA). Excludes sliding-window and linear/recurrent layers.

label: SWA : global
definition: attn.local_layers divided by attn.global_layers, the sliding-window to global interleave ratio (5 for '5 SWA : 1 global').

label: Linear : global
definition: attn.linear_layers divided by attn.global_layers (3 for '3 Gated DeltaNet : 1 GQA').

label: Sliding-window layers
definition: Layers with a fixed attention window.

label: Linear / SSM layers
definition: Layers with a fixed-size recurrent state (linear attention, DeltaNet variants, Mamba).

label: Query heads
definition: Query heads in the global-attention layers.

label: KV heads
definition: Key/value heads in the global-attention layers. Not applicable to MLA, whose cache is a shared latent.

label: Heads × head dim
definition: attn.heads × attn.head_dim, the query projection width of global layers.

label: Q heads / KV head
definition: attn.heads divided by attn.kv_heads in global layers.

label: QK head dim
definition: Query/key dimension per head in global-attention layers (for MLA, nope + rope dims).

label: V head dim
definition: Value dimension per head in global layers (MLA v_head_dim; stated for MLA even when equal to the QK head dim).

label: Window
definition: Sliding-window size of the local layers.

label: Long-window SWA layers
definition: Sliding-window layers (counted in attn.local_layers) that use attn.long_window instead of attn.window.

label: Long window
definition: Window of the attn.long_window_layers.

label: SWA KV heads
definition: KV heads in sliding-window layers (stated even when equal to attn.kv_heads).

label: SWA query heads
definition: Query heads in sliding-window layers (stated even when equal to attn.heads).

label: SWA QK head dim
definition: Query/key head dimension in sliding-window layers. Value head dimensions may differ; see attn.local_v_head_dim.

label: SWA value head dim
definition: Value head dimension in sliding-window layers, when separately specified. KV formulas use this value when present, otherwise the explicit global value dimension, or the local QK dimension when no separate value dimension is given.

label: MLA KV latent
definition: Width of the compressed KV latent that MLA caches per token per layer.

label: MLA Q latent
definition: Width of the low-rank query projection in MLA; 0 when queries use a full-rank projection.

label: Decoupled RoPE dim
definition: Width of the shared positional key that MLA caches next to the latent.

label: Positional encoding
definition: Positional scheme in global layers: RoPE, partial RoPE, NoPE, or mixed per layer type.

label: RoPE base
definition: RoPE base frequency of the global layers at release.

label: SWA RoPE base
definition: RoPE base frequency of the sliding-window layers (stated even when equal to attn.rope_theta).

label: Rotary fraction
definition: Fraction of each head's QK dimensions that are rotated.

label: QK norm
definition: Queries and keys are normalized per head before the dot product.

label: Output gate
definition: Gate applied to the attention output before the output projection, with its placement.

label: Attention logit softcap
definition: tanh soft-capping value applied to attention logits.

label: Sparse attention
definition: Token-selection mechanism inside global layers, e.g. DSA lightning indexer with top-k.

label: Attention scaling
definition: Query-key scaling when it is not 1/sqrt(head_dim), e.g. query_pre_attn_scalar, length-dependent (SSMax-style) scaling, or value scaling.

label: Attention sinks
definition: Learned sink logits or sink bias in the softmax, with the layer types that use them.

label: QKV bias
definition: Query/key/value projections have bias terms.

label: Linear-mixer details
definition: Configuration of the linear / SSM layers (e.g. Gated DeltaNet heads and dims, Mamba-2 state size), as one string.

label: Linear-mixer heads
definition: Value heads (or SSM heads) in the linear / SSM layers.

label: Linear-mixer head dim
definition: Head dimension of the linear / SSM layers (value head dim for DeltaNet variants, head_dim for Mamba-2).

label: Indexer key dim
definition: Width of the sparse-attention indexer key cached per token in each global layer (DSA lightning indexer), counted in the KV cache.

label: Cross-layer KV sharing
definition: Layers that reuse another layer's KV cache instead of computing their own (YOCO-style, cross-layer attention), and which layers own caches.

label: KV cache groups
definition: Cache owners and entry shapes for compressed or shared attention. Each item specifies layers owning the cache, scalar elements per entry (K and V together), tokens_per_entry (compression ratio, default 1), and optionally window (maximum entries retained). Completed compressed entries are floor(context / tokens_per_entry); incomplete compressor state is excluded. KV sizes use these groups when present.

label: KV storage formats
definition: Sourced storage components of attn.kv_groups. Each component names its group and gives elements, bits per element, format, scale_count, scale_bits and padding_bytes per entry. Different parts of one entry can have different formats. Sourced-storage sizes are available only when every group's elements are covered. These are inference-cache formats; they do not establish pretraining precision.

label: Short conv kernel
definition: Kernel size of the causal short convolution in linear / SSM layers or attention projections.

label: Activation
definition: FFN activation (SwiGLU, GeGLU, ...).

label: Dense FFN dim
definition: Intermediate width of the dense FFN layers that are actually executed.

label: Activation clamp
definition: Clamping of GLU gate / up activations (e.g. SwiGLU limit 7), with the layers it applies to.

label: FFN bias
definition: FFN projections have bias terms.

label: Dense FFN / d_model
definition: ffn.dim divided by shape.d_model.

label: Routed experts
definition: Routed experts per MoE layer.

label: Experts per token
definition: Routed experts selected per token.

label: Shared experts
definition: Always-on experts per MoE layer.

label: Expert dim
definition: Intermediate width of one routed expert.

label: Shared expert dim
definition: Total intermediate width of the shared expert(s).

label: Leading dense layers
definition: Number of initial blocks that use a dense FFN instead of MoE.

label: Router score
definition: Gating function over expert logits (softmax, sigmoid).

label: Load balancing
definition: Load-balancing method, with coefficients where disclosed.

label: Routed scaling factor
definition: Multiplier applied to the combined routed-expert output (routed_scaling_factor).

label: Renormalize top-k
definition: Selected expert weights are renormalized to sum to 1.

label: Group-limited routing
definition: Expert groups and groups selected per token, or node-limited routing, when used.

label: Expert latent dim
definition: Width of the projected space routed experts operate in (LatentMoE), when smaller than d_model.

label: Latent compression α (d_model / latent)
definition: shape.d_model divided by moe.latent_dim, how much LatentMoE compresses the hidden state before routed experts.

label: Expert dim / d_model
definition: moe.expert_dim divided by shape.d_model.

label: Sparsity (experts / top-k)
definition: Routed experts divided by experts selected per token.

label: Active / total
definition: params.active divided by params.total.

label: MTP depth
definition: Additional future tokens predicted during pretraining (0 when the model was trained without MTP).

label: MTP modules
definition: MTP modules with distinct weights. 1 with mtp.depth > 1 means one module is applied recursively.

label: MTP module
definition: Contents of one MTP module (mixer and FFN type, norms, how the previous hidden state and next-token embedding are combined).

label: MTP FFN
definition: FFN in the MTP module: 'dense' or 'MoE', with its width when it differs from the backbone.

label: MTP shares embedding/head
definition: MTP modules use the main model's input embedding and output head.

label: MTP params
definition: Parameters of all MTP modules as reported by the publisher.

label: MTP loss weight
definition: Weight of the MTP loss, including its schedule.

label: MTP weights released
definition: The released checkpoint contains the MTP module weights.

label: Norm
definition: Normalization layer type in the blocks.

label: Norm placement
definition: Pre-norm, post-norm, or sandwich (pre and post).

label: Final logit softcap
definition: tanh soft-capping value on output logits.

label: Norm epsilon
definition: Epsilon of the block normalization layers.

label: Residual stream
definition: Residual design when it is not a plain sum, e.g. hyper-connections with n streams, gated residuals, depth-scaled residuals, FP32 residual accumulation.

label: Embedding scaling
definition: Scaling or normalization applied to input embeddings (e.g. × sqrt(d_model), RMSNorm after embedding).

label: Output logit scaling
definition: Scaling applied to output logits other than a softcap (e.g. muP-style width multiplier).

label: Pretraining context
definition: Sequence length of the main pretraining stage.

label: Trained context
definition: Longest sequence length trained on after context extension.

label: Advertised context
definition: Longest context the publisher says the model supports, possibly beyond trained length via RoPE scaling.

label: Extension method
definition: How context was extended (stages, RoPE base change, YaRN factor).

label: Pretraining tokens
definition: Tokens seen in pretraining including annealing and context extension, as reported.

label: Optimizer
definition: Optimizer used for the bulk of parameters.

label: Peak LR
definition: Peak learning rate of the main pretraining stage.

label: Final LR
definition: Learning rate at the end of the decay.

label: LR schedule
definition: Learning-rate schedule shape with phase boundaries.

label: Warmup
definition: Warmup length in steps or tokens.

label: Batch schedule / notes
definition: Global batch size, including any batch-size ramp: sequences × sequence length (token total), or the token total alone when only that is stated.

label: Batch size (tokens)
definition: Global batch size in tokens during the main pretraining stage, after any ramp (sequences × sequence length when stated in sequences, marked inferred).

label: Weight decay
definition: Decoupled weight decay coefficient.

label: Adam betas
definition: (beta1, beta2) of the Adam-family optimizer or its AdamW fallback.

label: Grad clip
definition: Global gradient-norm clipping threshold.

label: Dropout
definition: Dropout rate applied during pretraining, with placement in the note. Recorded only when the publisher states it.

label: Training precision
definition: Matmul precision of pretraining (BF16, FP8 recipe, NVFP4 recipe) with the scaling granularity where disclosed. Never inferred from the released checkpoint dtype.

label: Initialization
definition: Weight initialization (std or scheme) as stated by the publisher; config initializer_range alone is not evidence.

label: Stability measures
definition: Interventions used during pretraining to keep it stable (QK-clip, z-loss, logit caps, spike handling), with coefficients.

label: Document masking
definition: Whether attention crosses document boundaries within a packed sequence.

label: Extra objectives
definition: Objectives beyond next-token prediction and MTP (fill-in-the-middle rate, distillation, multimodal tokens from the start).

label: Data mix
definition: Pretraining data composition as disclosed (domain shares, synthetic fraction, repetition).

label: Data cutoff
definition: Pretraining data cutoff date.

label: Hardware
definition: Accelerators used for pretraining, count and duration where stated.

label: Accelerators
definition: Accelerator count and type for the main pretraining run, as the count with thousands separators and the chip's short name ("2,048 H800", "2,048 GH200"). A stated range or bound stays as stated ("2,048–4,096 GH200").

label: Parallelism
definition: Parallelism layout of the main pretraining run as stated, as degree-annotated terms in the order TP, PP, VPP, EP, CP, DP ("PP16 · EP64 · ZeRO-1 DP"); a term without a stated degree has none ("FSDP").

label: Compute
definition: Pretraining compute as stated (GPU-hours or FLOPs).

label: Checkpoint averaging
definition: EMA or checkpoint merging applied to produce the released base weights.

label: Stages
definition: Ordered pretraining stages. Each item: name, tokens, seq_len, lr, batch_tokens, batch_sequences, steps, note, quote, and source when it differs from the fact's source.

label: Parametrization
definition: Width/depth parametrization used to transfer hyperparameters: SP (standard), μP, CompleteP, u-μP, depth-μP, with the multipliers that differ from SP. Only when stated.

label: HP selection rule
definition: How peak LR, batch size or other hyperparameters were chosen for the released run (fitted scaling law with its formula, μP transfer from a proxy width, sweep), as stated.

label: Scaling ladder
definition: Smaller models trained to choose the architecture or recipe (sizes, token budgets), as disclosed.

label: Tokens / param
definition: train.tokens divided by params.total.

label: Tokens / active param (non-embedding)
definition: train.tokens divided by params.counted_active_non_embedding, or by the stated params.active_non_embedding when there is no validated checkpoint count.

label: AdamW timescale τ
definition: B / (η λ D) with B = train.batch_tokens, η = train.lr_peak, λ = train.weight_decay and D = train.tokens: the AdamW EMA timescale as a fraction of training (Bergsma et al. 2025, Power Lines, arXiv 2505.13738). Computed only when the optimizer is AdamW; uses the peak LR.

label: KV bytes / token
definition: Retained KV cache divided by context length, including bounded SWA caches and indexer keys. Exports use uniform BF16 at 131,072 tokens. The website can select uniform payload precision (no quantization overhead) or sourced component formats (including scales and documented padding). This is cache payload, not peak prefill memory or persistent prefix storage.

label: Global KV bytes / token
definition: Long-context global KV bytes per token, including indexer keys; excludes bounded SWA caches. Compression rates and cross-layer cache reuse are included. Exports use uniform BF16; the website's storage selector also applies here. This is the field to compare with global-KV figures in reports, using the matching storage recipe.

label: KV bytes / token / B active
definition: kv.bytes_per_token divided by active parameters in billions (131,072 tokens in exports).

label: KV at context / B active
definition: kv.bytes_at_context divided by active parameters in billions (131,072 tokens in exports).

label: KV at context
definition: Retained KV cache for one sequence at the selected context, including SWA windows and indexer keys. Exports use uniform BF16 at 131,072 tokens. Excludes recurrent state, compressor tail state, draft/MTP caches, temporary prefill tensors, allocator metadata and persistent prefix snapshots. Does not estimate peak prefill or total serving memory.

label: AA Intelligence Index
definition: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 of the post-trained model, from a dated Wayback snapshot of its Artificial Analysis page. The note names the variant (reasoning setting).

label: DeepSWE pass@1
definition: DeepSWE v1.1 pass@1 (Datacurve; 113 tasks, same mini-swe-agent scaffold for every model), as a fraction.
